utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Nell — that’d be a huge help. It’s this Saturday at 9 on the front porch, and I’m still looking for a couple more helpers.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — Saturday at 9 on the front porch, and I’ll pass along that you still need a couple more helpers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Nell — I really appreciate you spreading the word. If you hear of anyone handy, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli — I could really use the help. It’s now Sunday at the community center, and I’m glad you’re coming by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday at the community center? I thought we were setting this up for Saturday at the front porch. I’ll need the correct time and place before I can help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: You’re right — I mixed that up. It’s Sunday at the community center, and I’d appreciate any help you can give.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear any changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Oren. As far as I know, the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, got it — Sunday at the community center now. Thanks for the update, Opal; I’ll spread the word if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring my toolbox and help sort the jobs when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s a big help, Leo — thank you. We still need a couple more volunteers for sorting and anyone who can bring extension cords or a first-aid kit.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring an extension cord and help with sorting too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’m organizing it this Saturday on the front porch, and I could use a few helpers. If you know what supplies are already covered, I’ll fill in the rest.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve got Rey, Oren, and Gus keeping an eye out, and Gus already offered the tools. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, that helps — I’ll note the tools are covered. If you hear of any missing supplies, send them my way, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Sam — that’s perfect. I’ll make sure we’ve got a spot ready for you at the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Dane — I appreciate it. I’ll be there Saturday and bring what I can to help get things set up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, Sam — your help will make a big difference. I’ll see you at the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great to hear—if anyone’s free, we could still use a few helpers at the front porch this Saturday, plus any tools or donated repair supplies. I’ll keep passing along updates as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I'll bring a few tools and help out at the front porch Saturday. Just tell me if there’s anything specific you still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Bo — that’s really helpful. I’ll pass along that we could still use any extra helpers or repair supplies if folks have them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah — it’s this Saturday on the front porch, and I’m organizing it. If you can help, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I can help out this Saturday at the front porch. Just let me know what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s great, Noah — thank you. I could use help sorting tools and handing them out to neighbors who stop by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know what they still need most for the repair drive, Ira?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not sure of the full list yet, but I know we still need a few more helpers for Saturday. I’ll ask around and let you know what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira. If you hear back, let me know—I can pitch in on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Hana — I’ll send the exact list soon, and please help spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—Sunday at the community center. I’ll spread the word and wait for the exact list so I can help keep track of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Hana — I really appreciate it. I’ll send the exact list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m not sure yet, but I can check what’s already covered and get back to you. What items are still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—what kind of repairs are we focusing on for the drive? I can bring over some tools if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mostly small home fixes—things like loose hinges, leaky faucets, and patching holes. If you can bring a basic tool set, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please send them — I want to make sure I’ve got the updated Sunday time and the community center location right before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday at the front porch, not Sunday, and I can send you the invite with the details so you can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, thanks — I have it as Sunday at the community center, so I’ll double-check before sharing it. Please send the invite and details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what’s already covered, and what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve got the word out and Oren’s already on the list, but I still need a few more helpers for Saturday at the front porch. Want me to add your name too?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—can you confirm what else is still needed besides helpers? I’m just checking what’s covered before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We still need basic hand tools, tape, screws, and a few extension cords if anyone has them. And if you can check what's already covered, that'd be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check what’s already covered and get back to you. We’ll need basic hand tools, tape, screws, and a few extension cords if anyone has them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Faye — that helps a lot. Just let me know what’s still missing when you check, and I’ll keep the porch list updated.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s this Saturday at my front porch, and I’m organizing it. If you can, please tell folks to come by with any tools or repairs they can help with.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I’ll spread the word about Saturday at your front porch and tell folks to bring any tools they can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — I really appreciate it. If anyone has extra tape, glue, or a small toolbox, that’d be great too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Gus — if you hear of anyone who can lend a hand this Saturday, please send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and send anyone I find your way this Saturday. Let me know if you still need any tools too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Gus — I might need a couple of tools, so I’ll let you know if I do.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It’s on Sunday at the community center now. Do you know what they still need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can check the list and bring the biggest gaps. If you know what’s still missing, tell me and I’ll try to cover it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet, but I’d check for tools and spare parts first. If you can bring a few basics, that should help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — we still need a few extra hands and any basic tools people can bring. If you can, please spread the word that it’s this Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and bring a few basic tools this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — that helps a lot. See you Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve heard the plan changed to Sunday at the community center. I’m still checking what items they’re collecting, but I’ll pass along any updates I get.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Sunday at the community center. Just let me know what they still need and I’ll help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still not sure on the exact item list, but I can confirm it’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — do you know who’s keeping the list of needed supplies?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure who’s holding the list, but I can check around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s this Saturday at the front porch, and I’m organizing it. If you can help spread the word, that’d be wonderful!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 9 works for me—what items are you collecting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: We’re collecting basic repair supplies like screws, nails, tape, glue, and small tools. If you spot anything useful, bring it along!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Just swing by when you can — I’ll keep the plans simple.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, Uli — I’ll swing by a bit later and keep it simple. Just let me know what you need most for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly I need someone to greet folks and keep the supplies moving. If you can help with that, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Rey—come by the front porch this afternoon and I’ll put you to work. We still need a few supplies, so your help will really count.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can come by this afternoon and help out at the front porch. Just let me know what supplies you still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Rey—could you pick up some duct tape and a box of assorted screws? If you can grab a small hammer too, that’d help a lot.
